title: The Quiet Interior
author: N. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Lena Sandoval, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
